post.summary: Schedule an interview
post.description: Recruiter only. Schedules an interview between the applicant of one application and one or more interviewers (active recruiters of the same enterprise), then emails the applicant and every interviewer. The time must be in the future and must not overlap another scheduled interview of the applicant or of any interviewer. An online interview needs a https `meetingLink`, an onsite one a `location`. The application status is not changed.
